insight: In Theme, a single ppOnAccent letter color fails on the muted absent-tile fill (near-black on dark-gray in dark mode, cream on light-gray in light mode). Absent + empty letters must use ppInk; reserve ppOnAccent for bright turf/ochre tiles only. Verify tile legibility in BOTH appearances.

Naming a ButtonStyle helper view nested struct `Body` collides with ButtonStyle.associatedtype Body — compiler infers associatedtype=your struct, then makeBody returning `some View` fails to conform. Name it Content/anything-but-Body. Also: View.tracking()/.kerning() are iOS16+; on Text they work (Text keeps returning Text) but on a generic view (e.g. ButtonStyle configuration.label) they break an iOS15 build.
